subject: Rstan broken after updating to development version of shinystan.

messages.author: 7069744c97b29f52
messages.subject: Rstan broken after updating to development version of shinystan.
parts:
Just like the title says. I was playing around with some models in stan and decided to finally give shinystan a whirl. I have the most recent version of ggplot (2.0.0, released to CRAN Dec 18th) and so following the advice of Jonah on the shinystan github (https://github.com/stan-dev/shinystan/issues/108) I updated to the development version of shinystan using this bit of code:
devtools::install_github("stan-dev/shinystan", ref = "version-2.0.2")

I should add, I only did that after first installing what I assume is a slightly earlier development shinystan version:
devtools::install_github("stan-dev/shinystan", build_vignettes = TRUE)

I was able to launch shinystan and load my already existing stanfit object. Shinystan is nifty, I like it (although the traceplots didn't appear to work for me). So then I go to rerun my model and encounter a fatal error. I will copy that error text below. I've tried removing and reinstalling the rstan package and the shinystan package (CRAN version). I've reinstalled Rtools and R (but didn't remove the existing installations; I will try that next). Still no dice. It is not the model, as I get the same error attempting to run the 8schools toy model.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Rstan broken after updating to development version of shinystan.
parts:
On Tuesday, January 5, 2016 at 11:52:26 AM UTC-5, Dalton Hance wrote:
I will uninstall and reinstall R and Rtools and see if that makes a difference.

You don't need to uninstall anything. It is just the same version mismatch issue that other people have pointed out and happens every time there is a major update to Stan. For now, you can download a binary version of rstan 2.9.0 for Windows from

http://win-builder.r-project.org/46ZTjEGxl4O9/

and do an "Install from a local zip file".

Ben
